title: Share the Judge, Learn the Deferral: Where Specialization Helps LLM Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2607.27984v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agentic systems generate outputs faster than human review. We contrast two LLM evaluator specialization strategies: specialized judge weights, or rule-based deferral policies for safe judgment acceptance. On 99,952 rubric-conditioned samples, correct rubrics improve accuracy by 2.11 points, while incorrect rubrics reduce performance by 2.66 points. Splitting training data across eight criterion-specific LoRA experts lowers accuracy by 10.05 points and reduces 5% error-bound coverage from 24.44% to 5.43%. This loss is independent of model size and training settings, with most performance recoverable by warm-starting experts from a unified judge. Sweeping data budgets confirms scratch expert specialization yields no empirical gains. Warm-started splits appear competitive with unified models, yet under limited data, unified training outperforms split training, with specialization beneficial only after unified training plateaus. Results

translated_title: 共享评判者，学习延迟策略：专业化在何处有助于大语言模型评估
translated_abstract: 智能体系统的输出速度超过了人工审查的速度。我们对比了两种大语言模型（LLM）评估器专业化策略：专门的评判者权重，或基于规则的延迟策略以确保安全的评判接受。在99,952个基于评分标准的样本上，正确的评分标准将准确率提高了2.11个百分点，而错误的评分标准则将性能降低了2.66个百分点。将训练数据分散到八个特定标准的LoRA专家中，准确率降低了10.05个百分点，并将5%误差界限覆盖率从24.44%降至5.43%。这种损失与模型大小和训练设置无关，且大部分性能可通过从统一评判者进行热启动专家来恢复。数据预算扫描证实，从头开始的专家专业化没有带来实证收益。热启动的分割模型似乎与统一模型相当，但在数据有限的情况下，统一训练优于分割训练，且专业化仅在统一训练达到平台期后才有益。结果...
tldr: 本研究对比了LLM评估器的两种专业化策略，发现从头训练的专家专业化会显著降低性能，而统一训练后热启动的分割模型仅在数据充足且统一模型达到平台期时才有效。
en_tdlr: This study compares two LLM evaluator specialization strategies, finding that scratch-trained expert specialization significantly degrades performance, while warm-started splits only benefit after unified training plateaus with sufficient data.
